steps.content: In the wheelhouse, you see a lean young man hunched over the controls, absorbed in his work. He doesn't seem to have noticed your arrival.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: This is Vikmar, our helmsman and navigator...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Don't be fooled by his face. He's top of his class at the maritime academy and a veteran with ten years of experience piloting large cargo ships.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: We haven't had a single accident since he took the helm. Pretty impressive, right?

steps.speaker: Vikmar
steps.content: I-it's the auto-navigation and steering systems doing all the work. I-I didn't do much...

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: But you're the one who keeps those systems running.

steps.speaker: Vikmar
steps.content: W-well, I suppose so... but th-there's still a lot I could do better...
The shy young man's ears turn red. He nervously wrings his hands, unsure what to do with them.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Don't stress yourself out. You're doing a great job. I know you'll get us home safe.
